Name: The Devil, Probably
Review:
“But would you kindly ponder this question: What would your good do if
evil didn't exist, and what would the earth look like if all the shadows
disappeared? After all, shadows are cast by things and people. Here is the shadow of my sword. But shadows also come from trees and living beings.

Do you want to strip the earth of all trees and living things just because
of your fantasy of enjoying naked light? You're stupid.”

― Mikhail Bulgakov, The Master and Margarita

Name: Landscape in the Mist
Review:
Running into the unknown.

Ah, to catch a misty dream.

Everything changed shape

During the flashes of wonder,

Even the border and then I was awake.

Was I unknowingly hugging a dream?

Name: Eternity and a Day
Review:
Today
​(which leads me to tomorrow)

​I
between red and yellow
wait like my mother
for the signal to change, while

​Love
calls me (in words I’ve yet to borrow)
like waves surrounding
my childhood home, where

​You
(who made me dance in tomorrow)
said tomorrow is as long as eternity.
